column1: # The I8 holdouts: each program that stops running when legacy's expression emitter goes, graded
# as an expected `cannot yet lower` refusal (tests/support/holdouts.ts, scripts/lib/holdouts.vl).
# One line per program, sorted: <program>\t<unit>\t<class>\t<owner>, the program a path or, for one
# a test writes inline, `tests/<file>.ts#<case>`. The list only shrinks
# (tests/ir_holdouts_test.ts); a holdout that is no longer refused reds until its line goes.
